findings.highlight: I see Sakura’s shoes
findings.evidenceJa: 玄関には桜の靴があった
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s shoes are at the entryway
findings.explanation: The evidence that Sakura has returned is detached from its concrete location.

findings.highlight: she is lying on the floor
findings.evidenceJa: 畳であお向けになっている
findings.governingReading: she is lying on her back on the tatami
findings.explanation: mirror moon drops both the tatami setting and Sakura’s supine posture.

findings.highlight: rather than having her head on the table
findings.evidenceJa: テーブルに突っ伏して、ではなく
findings.governingReading: rather than lying face-down over the table
findings.explanation: A specific collapsed posture is reduced to the location of her head.

findings.highlight: She was sick
findings.evidenceJa: 風邪ぎみだっていうのに
findings.governingReading: even though she seems to have a cold
findings.explanation: mirror moon strengthens a mild, current cold-like condition into categorical past sickness.

findings.highlight: helped around with my house
findings.evidenceJa: うちの手伝い
findings.governingReading: helped at our house or household
findings.explanation: The shared household frame becomes assistance with Shirou’s possession.

findings.highlight: I bring a blanket from my room
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋から毛布を持ってきた
findings.governingReading: he brought a blanket from a room
findings.explanation: mirror moon specifies Shirou’s bedroom where the source does not.

findings.highlight: I carefully drape the blanket over her
findings.evidenceJa: 寝た子を起こさないように毛布をかける
findings.governingReading: he quietly covers her, taking care not to wake a sleeping child
findings.explanation: The line’s tender child-sleeping comparison and explicit care not to wake Sakura disappear.

findings.highlight: empty eyes
findings.evidenceJa: 心ここにあらずという目
findings.governingReading: eyes suggesting that her mind is elsewhere
findings.explanation: Drowsy absence of attention is strengthened into emotional or mental emptiness.

findings.highlight: her gesture is more erotic than I’ve ever seen on her
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで見たこともないぐらい、色っぽい仕草だった
findings.governingReading: it was an alluring manner unlike anything he had seen from her before
findings.explanation: The English repeats “gesture” and turns Shirou’s limited perception into a comparative rating of eroticism.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s arms wrap around my neck
findings.evidenceJa: 白いものが首に巻きついてきた
findings.governingReading: something white and soft winds around his neck
findings.explanation: mirror moon immediately identifies the initially indirect white presence as Sakura’s arms, removing the perceptual reveal.

findings.highlight: I’m intensely aware of her femininity
findings.evidenceJa: 首に伸ばされた指と、もう目の前にある女の体
findings.governingReading: the fingers reaching around his neck and the woman’s body already before his eyes force themselves into view
findings.explanation: Concrete visual and bodily staging is replaced by an abstract awareness of femininity.

findings.highlight: no matter how hard I try to ignore it
findings.evidenceJa: 否応なしに視界に飛び込んでくる
findings.governingReading: the sight enters his field of vision whether he wants it or not
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents a sustained effort to ignore an abstract quality instead of the source’s involuntary perception.

findings.highlight: You need only look at her eyes to see that
findings.evidenceJa: とろんとした目で俺を見ているのが何よりの証拠だ
findings.governingReading: her looking at him with languid, unfocused eyes is the clearest proof
findings.explanation: The specific drowsy quality of Sakura’s gaze is omitted from the evidence that she is half-asleep.

findings.highlight: I have to shake her off me
findings.evidenceJa: こんなのはすぐに振りほどいて
findings.governingReading: he must immediately disentangle himself from this
findings.explanation: The object of disengagement shifts from the situation or hold to Sakura herself, making Shirou’s response more personally forceful.

findings.highlight: Her hair streams down her neck
findings.evidenceJa: 首筋から流れる髪
findings.governingReading: hair spills loosely from the nape of her neck
findings.explanation: The English changes the hair’s origin and presents a continuous downward movement.

findings.highlight: her breasts are pushing up her shirt
findings.evidenceJa: 大きく張り詰めた胸元
findings.governingReading: her full, taut chest
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents pressure against a shirt and makes the description more mechanically explicit.

findings.highlight: Having her mature woman’s body
findings.evidenceJa: 知らないうちに成長した体
findings.governingReading: a body that had grown without him noticing
findings.explanation: The mature body remains, but Shirou’s realization that Sakura grew without his noticing disappears.

findings.highlight: such boring senses
findings.evidenceJa: そんなつまらない良識
findings.governingReading: such trivial good sense or moral restraint
findings.explanation: mirror moon mistranslates moral judgment as plural sensory faculties.

findings.highlight: The sound of the pounding heart
findings.evidenceJa: 痛いとさえ思える心音
findings.governingReading: a heartbeat so forceful it seems painful
findings.explanation: The near-painful intensity of Shirou’s heartbeat is omitted.

findings.highlight: land on top of the table
findings.evidenceJa: 油断なくテーブルの上に着地する
findings.governingReading: lands on the table without letting his guard down
findings.explanation: The mock-combat vigilance that completes the exaggerated leap joke disappears.

findings.highlight: I was a bit surprised
findings.evidenceJa: 気が動転してた
findings.governingReading: he was badly flustered or thrown into confusion
findings.explanation: Shirou’s loss of composure is reduced to mild surprise.

findings.highlight: I slowly step down to the floor
findings.evidenceJa: のそのそとテーブルから降りる
findings.governingReading: he clambers or shuffles down from the table
findings.explanation: The sheepish, lumbering physical comedy becomes neutral slowness.

findings.highlight: Her hands are lowered
findings.evidenceJa: 伸ばしていた両手をぱたんと床に落として
findings.governingReading: both outstretched arms drop to the floor with a soft flop
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces an active, audible fall of both arms with a static passive posture.

findings.highlight: I want to train with you until dinner
findings.evidenceJa: 夕飯まで手合わせしたい
findings.governingReading: he wants to spar with Saber until dinner
findings.explanation: The concrete request for paired combat practice is generalized to training.

findings.highlight: Saber didn’t see us like that
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに見られなかった事
findings.governingReading: Saber did not see what was happening
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds a compromising “us like that” frame to Shirou’s relief.

findings.highlight: I would kill myself
findings.evidenceJa: 腹を切ってたところだぞ
findings.governingReading: he would have cut open his belly
findings.explanation: The exaggerated, concrete seppuku image is generalized to suicide.

findings.highlight: I would kill myself out of shame
findings.evidenceJa: 申し訳なくて腹を切ってた
findings.governingReading: he would feel so guilty or apologetic that he would cut his belly
findings.explanation: Concern over wronging a half-asleep Sakura becomes self-directed shame.
